top_concerns: Non-standard self-built six-task protocol with retrained baselines that look under-trained (e.g., Restormer 20.4 dB denoising, AirNet 8.9 dB low-light); no results on standard AIR benchmarks with official checkpoints
Latent encoder is pretrained on the same degradations as the test set with a discriminative regularizer, so it is not truly label-free; 'unseen' degradations are compositions of seen ones
Numbers inconsistent between abstract (1.68 dB), tables (+2.78 dB) and text (+5.64 dB desnowing vs +4.42 in Table 1)
Ablation shows the 3WD decoder gating accounts for most of the gain, not the latent prior; variants are undefined; Table 5 SA/CA baselines (7.7 dB worse) are implausible
'Linear attention' 3WD is just a sigmoid-gated Hadamard product with no token mixing; efficiency and 'reasoning' claims are overstated
